statement: ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : Space n × ℝ => density (ubar u q) p.1 p.2) {p | 0 < p.2} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : Space n × ℝ => densityRate (ubar u q) p.1 p.2) {p | 0 < p.2}
proof:
have hdot : ∀ (f g : Space n × ℝ → Value m),
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {p | 0 < p.2} →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g {p | 0 < p.2} →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => dot (f p) (g p)) {p | 0 < p.2} := by
  intro f g hf hg
  unfold dot
  exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ =>
    (contDiffOn_pi.mp hf k).mul (contDiffOn_pi.mp hg k))
have hv := h_T001.2.1
have hp := h_T001.2.2.1
have ha := h_T002.1
have hw := h_T002.2.2.1
constructor
· unfold density normSq
  exact (hdot _ _ hv hv).add (ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => hdot _ _ (hp j) (hp j)))
· unfold densityRate
  exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hdot _ _ hv ha)).add
    (contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => hdot _ _ (hp j) (hw j))))

checked : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : Space n × ↑(Set.Ioi 0) → Value m) (q : Value m),
  FirstCalculus (ubar u q) →
    SecondCalculus (ubar u q) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => density (ubar u q) p.1 p.2) {p | 0 < p.2} ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => densityRate (ubar u q) p.1 p.2) {p | 0 < p.2}
